{{Quote|Get back, Jedi. I am an apprentice to Darth Lachris, the vice president of Balmorra, and this man is under my protection.|Lerek Serrus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Lerek Serrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to [[Darth Lachris]] and vice president of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I will stand aside for you Jedi. Find another way to help my people.|Lerek thanking the Barsen'thor|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Lerek Serrus, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], lived on Balmorra when the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded the planet. Realizing that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was always holding his homeworld back he decided to collaborate with the Imperial occupation authorities. Believing this choice would help his family and people and bring glory to Balmorra in the end he joined the Empire. After rising through its ranks and falling for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] he became an apprentice to [[Darth Lachris]], the Sith Governor of Balmorra. As her protege he was given position of the vice president of Balmorra.

{{GameLS}}

During the Cold War, Lerek was present on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where he was ordered by his master to protect [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Trabier]] who was responsible for enslaving the people of Balmorra. When the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] arrived, Lerek stood in front of Trabier to protect him and warned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to stand back. He explained to the Consular about the protection of his family and the people that he cares about in order to bring hope and victory that his master was going to bring. Barsen'thor redeemed him to let go of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and to protect his family and the people he cared about. Lerek defied his master and Trabier by defecting from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't try to confuse me. My path is clear. My family has always lived here, watching Republic interference hold Balmorra back. But Darth Lachris can lead us to glory.|Lerek Serrus's personality|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
==Behind the scenes==
The fate of Lerek is decided by the player, by choosing one of the three speech options that are given. The first option will result in Lerek telling the player about his family, and the player will be able to persuade him to return to his family and let go of the dark side. In the second option, the player tries to redeem him, but Lerek engages the Jedi nonetheless, and is killed in the fight. At last, the third option, which will be awarded with Dark side points if chosen, the player would just engage Lerek, killing him.
